subject.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro: textSignature bloat + think tags + mixed text/tool causes session failures

question: What retention and replay contract should OpenClaw use for Gemini visible textSignature values on same-route Google history?
rationale: Current code and tests intentionally replay valid same-route Google signatures, while this issue shows that unbounded visible-text signatures can bloat sessions and abort channel replies; changing it safely needs provider-owner direction.

options.title: Bound visible-text signatures
options.body: Preserve required tool-call and native-thinking signatures but cap, drop, or externalize visible textSignature values before replay.

options.title: Keep current replay
options.body: Accept ongoing session-bloat risk in exchange for preserving every current same-route Gemini signature.

options.title: Split policy first
options.body: Open a narrower Google signature-retention design item and keep implementation blocked until maintainers choose the contract.

recommendation.title: Bound visible-text signatures
recommendation.body: Preserve required tool-call and native-thinking signatures but cap, drop, or externalize visible textSignature values before replay.

likelyOwner.reason: This person appears in recent related Gemini reasoning and earlier signature-bloat history and is the best available routing owner from the inspected evidence.
